_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_enters_as_graveyard_copy.py. t_eagc_ezri is Ezri Dax, Newly Joined: a legendary 1/3 Trill Advisor with flash that may enter as a copy of a creature card in its controller's graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn, except her name stays her own and she is a legendary Trill in addition to the copied types.

cards.name: Test Ezri, Newly Joined
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
You may have Test Ezri enter as a copy of any creature card in your graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn, except her name is Test Ezri, Newly Joined and she's a legendary Trill in addition to her other types.
